text: On-chain governance systems outperform traditional governance models in responsiveness only if they incorporate robust anti-collusion measures, a requirement SPoS meets through its cryptographic commitments.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Cryptographic Foundations and Interdisciplinary Dimensions of the Secure Proof of Stake (SPoS) Conse (2025). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=5225296

isBasedOn.name: Cryptographic Foundations and Interdisciplinary Dimensions of the Secure Proof of Stake (SPoS) Conse

abstract: Recent studies of on-chain governance in DAOs suggest that such systems can outperform traditional models in responsiveness, provided they incorporate robust anti-collusion measures—a challenge SPoS addresses through its cryptographic commitments

additionalProperty.name: scope_conditions
value: requires robust anti-collusion measures to be in place
